relationships.subject: STAT3
relationships.evidence_quote: the expression of S100A6 is enhanced through transcriptional regulation by STAT3

relationships.subject: S100A6
relationships.evidence_quote: the interaction between S100A6 and P53 not only promotes the expression of P53 but also enhances its phosphorylation and nuclear accumulation

relationships.subject: P53
relationships.evidence_quote: Once in the nucleus, P53 suppresses the transcription of SLC7A11, thereby promoting ferroptosis in NPCs and the degradation of the ECM

key_findings: STAT3 drives S100A6, which enhances P53 and suppresses SLC7A11, promoting NPC ferroptosis and ECM degradation.
S100A6 knockout alleviates IVDD in mice.
